'''The Rank''' was an [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] dead zone in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]].<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

Around [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]], boats traveling through the Rank were attacked by a flotilla of [[Menahuun]].<ref name="BL" /> Inhabitants of the nearby [[Cape Regret]] believed that the Rank was expanding itself, destroying the jungle around their coast.<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the dark ending of the adventure ''[[Reckonings]]'', [[Miss Mylla]] leaves [[Bartyn's Landing]] to start anew in [[Little Mon Cal]], but his ship accidentally runs aground in the western part of the Rank. [[Mix Liddell]] believed that the Menahuun would probably discover the boat and attack, and prompted his friends to save her.
